canonical_name: Classification of finite simple groups (exact 18-family taxonomy and formal target open)
literal_source_claim_zh: 所有有限单群属于18个无穷族或26个散在群
literal_source_claim_en: Every finite simple group belongs to one of 18 infinite families or is one of 26 sporadic groups.
source_attribution: Many mathematicians, 1983 (catalog metadata only; not a source citation)
candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For every finite simple group G, prove a source-selected classification up to group isomorphism into exactly the source-defined prime-cyclic, alternating, Lie-type, and sporadic representatives, with the exact 18-family convention, every admissible parameter and exclusion, the Tits-group convention, and the source-selected exhaustiveness or uniqueness conclusion.
statement_blocker: The catalog slogan does not define the family datatype, representatives, admissible parameters, low-rank exclusions, central quotients, exceptional isomorphisms, the complete sporadic enumeration, the Tits-group convention, the isomorphism relation, or whether the result asserts exhaustiveness only or unique classification data. Tatitscheff's exact-wording secondary witness explains the count but does not close these formal and primary-source boundaries. Choosing definitions or a conclusion now would invent proposition-changing mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted source and formal design must fix the carrier universe, Group and finiteness interfaces, nontriviality and simplicity convention, representative universe, finite-field and matrix-group foundations, quotient constructions, and every family parameter type and admissibility predicate.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose a typed exhaustive disjunction, an existence statement up to MulEquiv, a unique classification datum, pairwise nonisomorphism, or a conjunction of these conclusions.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no canonical proposition is frozen; all trivial, abelian, small-degree, low-rank, small-field, quotient, duplicate-presentation, exceptional-isomorphism, and Tits-group cases in scope-map.md remain open.
candidate_scope_not_credited: an exhaustiveness theorem classifying every finite simple group up to MulEquiv into actual representatives
the 18 families counted as prime cyclic, alternating, and 16 source-selected Lie-type families

degenerate_cases_to_resolve: the trivial group and the source-specific nontriviality convention for simple groups

excluded_substitutions: the common four-class summary without a checked source bridge to the literal 18-family count
classification of finite abelian simple groups, A5 simplicity, odd-order solvability, or any single recognition or family theorem as the full classification
a predicate or structure field that assumes the desired classification disjunction
